title: Homework: Good or Bad?
text:
Many people think that homework is useful for students. They say it helps students practise what they learn in class. However, some students feel tired after school and do not have time to relax.

In my opinion, students should have less homework. Children need time to play, read and spend time with their families. A short and simple task is better than a long one.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what do some people say homework helps students do?
options: Practise what they learn in class

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what do children need time for?
options: To play, read and spend time with their families
To cook dinner for their parents
To go to work after school
To learn a new language at school

questions.text: Why does the writer think a short homework task is better?
options: Children have little free time and need to rest and play
Teachers prefer short tasks because they are faster to grade
Short tasks are easier to find in books
Long tasks are not allowed in most schools

questions.text: What can the reader infer about the writer's opinion on homework?
options: The writer believes students have too much homework
The writer thinks homework should be removed completely
The writer enjoys long homework tasks
The writer does not have an opinion about homework

vocabulary.definition: to do an activity again and again to get better at it
needing rest or sleep because of too much activity
groups of people who are related to each other

paragraph_translations: Muitas pessoas acham que o dever de casa é útil para os alunos. Elas dizem que ele ajuda os alunos a praticar o que aprendem na aula. No entanto, alguns alunos se sentem cansados depois da escola e não têm tempo para relaxar.
Na minha opinião, os alunos deveriam ter menos dever de casa. As crianças precisam de tempo para brincar, ler e passar tempo com suas famílias. Uma tarefa curta e simples é melhor do que uma longa.
